ideas.title: AI agents with their own Sui-native wallets and capabilities
ideas.summary: Framework for AI agents that hold capabilities, pay for compute and data via on-chain ops, and produce verifiable receipts.
ideas.fitForSui: Capabilities give agents granular permissions. Sponsored gas hides crypto from agent-facing flows.
ideas.marketSignal: Agent-native infra is a recurring 2026 VC thesis.

ideas.title: Creator content vaults backed by Walrus
ideas.summary: Creators store master content on Walrus with on-chain access tokens. Buyers receive a capability that decrypts and streams.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores the blob; capabilities gate access; zkLogin handles fan onboarding.
ideas.marketSignal: Creator-economy primitives remain underbuilt on every chain.

ideas.title: Order routing aggregator across DeepBook pools
ideas.summary: A router that splits orders across the deepest DeepBook pools and adjacent AMMs (Cetus, Aftermath) for best execution.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook's central limit orderbook plus AMM aggregation, executed atomically via PTBs.
ideas.marketSignal: Aggregator demand grows with DeepBook volume.

ideas.title: Encrypted medical records with patient-controlled keys
ideas.summary: Patients hold a capability that decrypts records stored on Walrus. Providers request access; access events are audited on-chain.
ideas.fitForSui: Capabilities for granular consent. Walrus for encrypted record storage. zkLogin for patient onboarding.
ideas.marketSignal: YC has called out healthcare records repeatedly in RFS.

ideas.title: Hackathon submission receipts as verifiable Sui Objects
ideas.summary: Each hackathon team's submission is a Sui Object linking deploy artifacts, video, deck, and judges. Public, verifiable timeline.
ideas.fitForSui: Objects with capabilities for judges. PTBs to mint, score, and publish.
ideas.marketSignal: Sui Overflow 2026 itself is a venue. Could become a standard for any hackathon.

ideas.title: Cross-app loyalty passport with zkLogin
ideas.summary: Users sign in once with zkLogin and accumulate loyalty across participating apps. Each app earns a capability to grant points.
ideas.fitForSui: zkLogin removes wallet onboarding. Capabilities scope point-grant authority.
ideas.marketSignal: Loyalty programs are a recurring crypto-x-loyalty pitch with no standout consumer winner yet.

ideas.title: Music master files on Walrus with on-chain royalty splits
ideas.summary: Master audio stored on Walrus, royalty splits as Move objects, payouts as PTBs to collaborator addresses.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus for masters, capabilities for collaborator splits, PTBs for atomic payout.
ideas.marketSignal: Royalty splitting is a recurring music-tech x crypto thesis.

ideas.title: Perpetuals using DeepBook as the settlement venue
ideas.summary: A perpetuals platform that settles funding and fills via DeepBook orderbooks rather than a custom AMM.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook's CLOB makes funding-rate computation cheap on-chain.
ideas.marketSignal: Perpetuals dominate DeFi volume across chains; Sui-native perps are emerging.

ideas.title: Prediction market settled on DeepBook
ideas.summary: Outcome markets where shares trade on DeepBook orderbooks, settling at resolution.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook settles share trades; Sui Objects represent outcome shares.
ideas.marketSignal: Polymarket validated demand; multi-chain prediction markets remain underbuilt.

ideas.title: Tokenized RWA vault on Scallop
ideas.summary: A vault that mints a Sui token backed by tokenized real-world assets and earns yield via Scallop money markets.
ideas.fitForSui: Scallop for yield, capabilities for issuer authority, Move types for asset class.
ideas.marketSignal: RWA yield is a top crypto theme heading into 2026.

ideas.title: Research data marketplace on Walrus with Move-defined licenses
ideas.summary: Datasets stored on Walrus, licenses encoded as Sui Objects, access events on-chain.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus for storage, capabilities for license enforcement, PTBs for payout.
ideas.marketSignal: Data licensing for ML training is a top YC RFS topic.

ideas.title: One-click leveraged yield strategies on Scallop
ideas.summary: Vaults that loop deposit and borrow on Scallop to compound yield, with risk parameters set by the user.
ideas.fitForSui: Scallop lending plus PTB composition for atomic loop.
ideas.marketSignal: Leveraged strategies are a perennial DeFi UX win.

ideas.title: Sponsored-transaction onboarding as a service
ideas.summary: A drop-in service for Sui dapps that sponsors first N transactions per user, with rate limits and abuse protection.
ideas.fitForSui: Sponsored transactions plus capabilities for rate-limit policy.
ideas.marketSignal: Onboarding friction is the top reason for dapp churn; gasless solves it.

ideas.title: AI training credit system with Sui-native receipts
ideas.summary: Compute providers issue capability-based training credits. Spending is metered and verifiable on-chain.
ideas.fitForSui: Capabilities meter compute spending. PTBs for atomic credit transfers.
ideas.marketSignal: AI compute credits are a recurring infra thesis.

ideas.title: Sui-native creator subscriptions with kiosk-priced tiers
ideas.summary: Creators publish subscription tiers as Kiosk listings. Payment unlocks a capability that decrypts content from Walrus.
ideas.fitForSui: Kiosk for tier listing, Walrus for content, capabilities for unlock.
ideas.marketSignal: Substack ARR shows demand; crypto-native subs remain unsolved.
